text:
carmen: Quick follow-up to the RFC about long-term modularization: proposal for a 'soft-fence' pattern when extracting the model-profile registry from core runtime. Objective: allow independent release cadence while minimizing production surprises.

hugo: Soft-fence? explain the mechanics.

carmen: Mechanics: 1) Introduce an interface shim in core that proxies to either local in-process registry (legacy) or remote registry service (new). 2) Use runtime feature flags to flip tenants to remote registry per-tenant. 3) Dual-read for 2w, then dual-write for 2w, with sampling for model-profile deltas. 4) Observable diffs: daily aggregate of profile mismatches (hash diffs) and per-request model-selection trace id linking.

drew: Key failure modes: model selection divergence (leading to wrong quantization/variant), read-latency spikes, consistency windows when profiles update during in-flight setups.

eva: For consistency, ensure registry updates are versioned and immutable. Use epoched profiles and require consumers to fetch by version token. Also provide backward-compat compatibility: legacy fallback to last-known-good profile if remote fails.

hugo: What about DB migrations and secret scoping? The registry will now hold per-tenant scoring knobs. Migrations must be reversible.

carmen: Plan: - export profiles + tags (v0) -> import into remote service as v1 objects with idempotency token; - run verification job that compares selection outcomes across both paths for sampled requests. If mismatch > 0.5% for 24h, pause rollout.

drew: Observability: add a model-profile diff dashboard, heatmap of the most divergent tenants, and spike detectors for selection churn.

hugo: Also add a migration safety switch: ability to mute remote registry per-tenant (fall back instantly).

deploy-bot: Canary started: registry-service canary on infra-region-2.

eva: I'll write the migration e2e tests and the import/export script. Estimate 3d to produce and 1d to run verification across staging.

carmen: Updated timeline: spike + local shim (1w), internal canary (2d), tenant ramp (10% steps over 4w with diff monitoring), full cutover, 2w stability, then deprecate local path. Owners: carmen (orchestration), eva (migration/tests), hugo (db/secret ops), drew (observability).

carmen: Posting RFC update and runbook link; tagging @eva for tests and @hugo for ops. Keep comments short so we can lock this in by EOD.
